items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His nephew. Well, his uncle. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Well, he come from down there, you know. That's his hometown.

ctx.x: With Ben Coe and D.D. They had Hollywood. Jim Robinson. You know the fella next door there? Jim? Jim Robinson? Yeah, right next- Jim? Not Jim Robinson. Jim Little. Oh, oh yeah.
Yes. Well, he come from down there, you know. That's his hometown.
